test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five girls A, B, C, Z and U are sitting in a row, facing towards the south (but not necessarily in the same order). No one is sitting to the right of A. Three girls are sitting to the left of U. B is second to the left of C. Who is sitting second to the left of U?
solution:
**Explanation : **

 
• Three girls are sitting to the left of U.
 
• No one is sitting to the right of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f720dfd62de7b722ac17986d7518beefceeecb7fdc0534eee5cd4cef3b1aca99.png] 

B is second to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fc6348dc2fd2cbc780a93604cf77dfc39678e8e529bc18beb29b53833ce7698.png] 

**Z** is sitting second to the left of U.

Hence, **Option 2) **is the correct answer.
